name: cl_disp5_allday_k1p5

source.title: Claude's variant 2026-10-20 of the pipeline's nq_displace_nyam (5-minute displacement follow, k 1.5): candle stop and 1:1 instead of the table, 09:30 to 15:00, one trade per session pass

entry.words: A 5-minute candle whose body is at least 1.5 x ATR(14) of the candles before it is a displacement: enter at its close in its direction. Stop at the candle's other extreme, target 1:1. One trade per session pass (morning, midday, afternoon).

taught: [pipeline card nq_displace_nyam] a candle with a body well over the recent typical size is orders filled at any price, and the push tends to carry on
[Claude 2026-10-20] candle stop, 1:1, all three New York passes
not_run: THE CAP: one per session pass (nyam, mid, pm): up to three trades a day.
COSTS AND FILLS: the engine's own (1 tick of slippage, $4 a round turn, tick replay).
THE TEST DAYS (2025-07-01 on) ARE NOT READ: build days only.
A stop floor of 0.25 x ATR applies when the candle's extreme is nearer than that.
FLAT: every trade is flat by 15:58 ET (13:13 on half days).
